Man, five months of dealing with that would drive me nuts. And the fact that you can hit those 1K reps at your normal pace, but the easy running between them becomes painful, is definitely something I'd pay attention to. If it were me, I wouldn't keep trying to run through it or just keep throwing different creams and recovery tricks at it. Since it's been hanging around this long, I'd get the physio to reassess it and look at the whole picture with running mechanics, strength, training load, and what specifically triggers the pain. Cutting your mileage was a good move, but sometimes reducing the miles alone doesn't fix what's causing the problem. I'd rather figure that out before trying to push those race paces again.
